tests.name: makes the same calls and output for the same start, seed, and results
tests.note: Pinned seed1/seed0 values, time-independent random, Date clock and serial delivered clock tested. Upstream performance.now and complete call/output equivalence not covered.

tests.name: runs in UTC whatever the host's timezone, and without WeakRef or FinalizationRegistry
tests.note: Deterministic UTC offset and absent GC intrinsics verified. Ordinary execute host-timezone/GC mode is not exposed by native durable sandbox.

tests.name: applies results in seq order, whatever order they are delivered in
tests.note: Upstream out-of-order parallel delivery requires ordered results and idle/issued protocol. Native serial adapter rejects overlap; rejection is not parity.

tests.name: reports the fingerprint before any call and the calls issued after each result
tests.note: Persisted host/guest identity and mismatch rejection covered. Started/fingerprint/idle events, budget/heap fingerprint and exact upstream format are absent.

tests.name: numbers calls to globals with tools, and answers errors as rejections
tests.note: Native Go structured delivery types replace generic JSON wire answers; no equivalent pending-run unserializable answer rejection test.

tests.name: keeps the clock monotonic and rejects a clock value that is not finite
tests.note: Error-plus-result union is rejected natively; generic reject.properties plain-object validation has no direct native counterpart/test.

tests.name: reports the result the VM was processing when the script ended
tests.note: Upstream rejection properties preserve Error instances and custom structuredOutput. Native script bridge does not establish that property contract.

tests.name: leaves a call waiting when its answer cannot be serialized
tests.note: Serial delivery clock advances and backward deliveries clamp at previous clock, with replay identity host39. int64 transport excludes nonfinite values; upstream performance.now and generic JSON rejection contract still not covered.

tests.name: rejects with an Error carrying the answer's properties
tests.note: Finish during.seq/issued watermark and finish-event clock freezing protocol not implemented.

tests.name: rejects rejection properties that are not an object, and tools sharing a script name
tests.note: Context cancellation termination covered. Upstream caller abort reason, cleared output and idempotent post-abort delivery contract not fully matched.

tests.name: uses the script names the run passes
tests.note: Completion watermark field during is absent; ordinary execute mode is not exposed by native durable sandbox.

tests.name: ends with an error the script cannot catch when the caller aborts
tests.note: Go deliveries are typed. Direct execute rejection of stale/double delivery and during protocol has no pinned equivalent coverage.

tests.name: is finished once it has its outcome
tests.note: Sanitized identifier collisions rejected; upstream duplicate start/builtins target set not exhaustively matched.

tests.name: rejects a call that is not waiting and a result number used twice
tests.note: Sanitized aliases and original tool dispatch covered; upstream arbitrary jsName including explicit undefined has no direct native API counterpart.

tests.name: applies results in seq order when the transport reorders replies sent in order
tests.note: Cancellation terminates bounded VM. Upstream ordinary execute cleared-output abort result contract not exposed.

tests.name: reads the real clock and real randomness
tests.note: Native engine supplies seeded/clock-driven environment for every invocation. Upstream ordinary execute real clock/random mode is missing.
